guard_region.evidence: Zero padding after the last W3 instruction and inside the W3 copy range, so original startup copies it to DRAM with the surrounding code.

text_relocation.evidence: Original startup runs MAIN text in place, then copies each window's content to DRAM and remaps the whole window. Bytes a package places between copy_end and remap_end are replaced by unwritten DRAM. The in-place range is never remapped. Static trace, confirmed by a read-only page-table walk on a stock C2.01 camera.
